video_title: Can Lethal Shooter Really Get Shaq to Make 15 Free Throws Straight?

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter on his process for training different types of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: sometimes with certain celebrities, their brains is doing a little bit more than professional athletes
quotes.quote: If I do a CAD or Dr. Dre or Miss Rachel or Justin Bieber, of course it's not a Carmelo. Carmelo, I'm getting technical. Jaylen Brown, I need you to be here with the hand placement. But sometimes with certain celebrities, their brains is doing a little bit more than professional athletes for me to change something within the hour and a half or two hours. So if I see that their shot is already consistent, respectful to that shot, I would say, you know what, make five. And then if you can make five like that, unfortunately, we just got to keep that.
quotes.social_post: Lethal Shooter explains his training philosophy noting that he adjusts his technical approach based on whether he is working with an NBA star like Carmelo Anthony or a celebrity client.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter on why he doesn't train all NBA players together
quotes.excerpt: I don't train all NBA guys together. You know why? Because y'all are not him.
quotes.quote: I don't train all NBA guys together. You know why? Because y'all are not him. Him, I got to train ISO. I got to put three guys on him. He got to go off the dribble going right, pull up, pump fake, pump fake, shot. He got to come down in transition, split, pull up. You just got to come off screens. You just got to go in the lane, work on the left hand, right hand floater.
quotes.social_post: Lethal Shooter says he does not train all NBA players together because their roles differ, noting he trains some guys for ISO heavy play while others are strictly off ball shooters.
